category_title: Students exhibiting explicit acts of misbehavior and physical aggression
minimal_context: The student is in a high school English class being asked to settle down and open their notebook for instructions during the last ten minutes of the lesson.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please take your seats and open your notebooks so I can give you the instructions for the last ten minutes of class.

STUDENT: (Talking loudly to a classmate) I'm not doing any in-class work right now, I didn't even do the homework.

TUTOR: We need to settle down and listen to the instructions now.

STUDENT: Why? The last ten minutes is the only time we have left, I'm not following any more instructions today.

TUTOR: You still need to be seated and follow the instructions I give you.

STUDENT: Relax, viejo. You're taking this too seriously, just let us talk.

options.A: Place a hand on the student's shoulder during the exchange.
options.B: Ignore the student's behavior, provided it is safe to do so.
options.C: Make the instructions clear and give them before grouping the students.
options.D: Walk around the classroom and stand directly behind the student.
